asA: stage-keeper running Finalise and the release cut
iWant: merges from main, lockfiles, declared-generator outputs, status records and the release cut to pass as FINALISE: commits, and anything else to fail
soThat: chores never need a separation exception and a code change can never ride in as a chore
description: FINALISE file classes, declared generators and judged merges (Q-02 refinements 1 and 4).
title: The stage-keeper commits FINALISE chores within the FINALISE file classes

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture commit "FINALISE: release 1.1.0" touching rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, CHANGELOG.md, releases/releases.yaml and package.json, where the package.json diff changes only the "version" line, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 and the commit counts under FINALISE with classes chainStatus, lockfile, release and versionField.

[failure] Given three fixture commits "FINALISE: deps" changing a dependency line in package.json, "FINALISE: fix" touching src/a.js and "FINALISE: notes" touching docs/x.md, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the items "<s7> FINALISE: changes package.json beyond its \"version\" line (class production, owned by BUILD)", "<s7> FINALISE: touches src/a.js (class production, owned by BUILD)" and "<s7> FINALISE: touches docs/x.md (class neutral, owned by DEFINE, BUILD)".

[happy] Given rcf/separation.json at the head declaring {"generators": [{"id": "queue-goldens", "command": "node bin/rcf.js build queue --format json > test/build/fixtures/queue.json", "outputs": ["test/build/fixtures/queue.md", "test/build/fixtures/queue.json"], "checkedBy": "test/build/queue.test.js"}]} with test/build/queue.test.js present, and a commit "FINALISE: regenerate queue goldens" carrying the trailer "Generated-By: queue-goldens" and touching test/build/fixtures/queue.json and rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json, when rcf audit separation --json runs, then it exits 0 and that commit's row reads classes ["chainStatus", "generatorOutput"] and generators ["queue-goldens"].

[failure] Given the generator declaration of the happy case, when one FINALISE: commit touches test/build/fixtures/queue.json with no Generated-By: trailer, a second carries "Generated-By: view-baseline" (not declared) and a third carries "Generated-By: queue-goldens" but touches test/view/fixtures/phase-3-6-static.html (not among its outputs), then rcf audit separation exits 4 with "<s7> FINALISE: touches test/build/fixtures/queue.json (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)", "<s7> Generated-By: view-baseline is not declared in rcf/separation.json" and "<s7> FINALISE: touches test/view/fixtures/phase-3-6-static.html (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)".

[failure] Given rcf/separation.json at the head whose generators[0] lacks checkedBy, or has "outputs": [], or names a checkedBy file absent at the head, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 2 with stderr "separation: malformed rcf/separation.json: generators[0].checkedBy is required", "separation: malformed rcf/separation.json: generators[0].outputs must list at least one glob" or "separation: malformed rcf/separation.json: generators[0].checkedBy <path> does not exist at <h7>" respectively, and prints no PASS or FAIL line.

[happy] Given a fixture branch with a merge commit "FINALISE: merge main" from the base branch whose result equals the automatic merge (no combined-diff paths) and a second merge "FINALISE: merge main again" whose only combined-diff path is pnpm-lock.yaml, when rcf audit separation --json runs, then it exits 0, both rows read merge true and stage "FINALISE", the second lists paths ["pnpm-lock.yaml"], and the PASS line counts merges 2.

[failure] Given a fixture merge commit "FINALISE: merge main" whose conflict resolution edits src/a.js (src/a.js in its combined diff), and a merge commit "Merge branch 'main' into feature" with no prefix, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with "<s7> FINALISE: merge resolution touches src/a.js (class production); a merge that needs a code fix goes back to BUILD in a new round" and "<s7> no stage prefix".

[must-not] rcf audit separation never runs a declared generator's command or any process other than git: over the passing generator fixture, a spawn seam that records child processes records only git, and a declared command that would write a marker file leaves no marker after the run.
